page_title: Password Manager, Secrets, and Access Management | 1Password

summary.name: 1Password
summary.one_liner: 1Password is a password and secrets management platform for people, machines, and AI agents, offering enterprise credential vaulting, runtime credential delivery, privileged access, and SaaS/AI spend management.
use_cases: Storing and sharing business passwords and secrets
Giving AI agents and machine workloads only the credentials they need
Discovering and governing SaaS apps and AI tool usage
Auditing access across people and machines
Optimizing AI token and SaaS license spend
summary.what_it_does: The page presents 1Password as a vault for identities, credentials, and secrets used by humans, AI agents, and machines. Its Enterprise Password Manager covers human, machine, and agent credentials. Credential Broker verifies AI agents and machine workloads at runtime and delivers only the credentials each is authorized to receive. Privileged Access is described as enforcing zero standing privilege through just-in-time and just-enough access. SaaS Manager is described as discovering AI and SaaS apps, securing access, and optimizing spend on AI tokens and SaaS licenses.
notable: Credential Broker verifies AI agents and machine workloads at runtime before delivering credentials
Zero standing privilege via just-in-time and just-enough access
SaaS Manager covers AI token and SaaS license spend optimization
Named a Leader for SaaS Management Platforms (per page)
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; enterprise-oriented offerings with trial links only
Page is largely marketing copy with few technical specifics
